page: Amazon Web Services m9gd.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by custom 64-bit ARMv9 AWS Graviton Neoverse-V3 processors. Operating at 3.3 GHz, this instance features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs, utilizing a single thread per core architecture. The hardware configuration includes 192 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 2850 GB of NVMe SSD instance store capacity. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-core processing capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core performance scoring in the top 25%. The memory subsystem demonstrates high efficiency, achieving top-tier results in PassMark memory tests and small-block read-only bandwidth of 6318.61 GB/sec. Data processing tasks show exceptional throughput, with single-threaded gzip compression reaching 36.5 GB/sec and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaching 635.79 GB/sec. Database operations are highly optimized, as evidenced by Redis SET operations executing at 136.39 million operations per second and PassMark database operations scoring in the top 10%.

While the instance delivers top-tier performance in static web serving and prompt processing for small LLM models, it exhibits a notable performance tradeoff in text generation, where small model text generation falls into the bottom 10% at 31.56 tokens/sec. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the integration of high-capacity local NVMe SSD storage alongside dedicated Graviton cores provides excellent resource density for data-intensive workloads without requiring external storage attachments. This profile makes the m9gd.12xlarge highly suitable for high-throughput database hosting, Redis caching layers, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
